column3: MT 4:14. “Cut yourself” is rendered “muster yourselves in troops”; NASB renders “someone has set” as “They have laid.”

MT 5:1. “Insignificant” is rendered “Too little,” and “families” “clans”; “origins” is rendered “goings forth,” and “from antiquity, from days of antiquity” “from long ago, From the days of eternity.”
MT 5:2. “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel,” and “brothers” “brethren”; “will return with” is rendered “Will return to.”
MT 5:3. NASB supplies “His flock” and renders “now” as “at that time.”
MT 5:4. “This one will be peace” is rendered “this One will be our peace”; “Assyria” is rendered “the Assyrian,” and “princes of man” “leaders of men.”
MT 5:5. “Assyria” is rendered “the Assyrian”; NASB supplies “us.”
MT 5:6. “Copious showers” is rendered “showers,” and “children of humankind” “sons of men.”
MT 5:8. The Hebrew jussives (“may it be lifted up … may they be cut off”) are rendered as futures.
MT 5:13. “Pluck up” is rendered “root out,” and “Asherah poles” “Asherim.”
